erros.devolutiva: Praticar divisão longa para encontrar o quociente (inteiro) e o resto (numerador).

dicas.texto: Você está indo bem! Lembre-se: se a reta está dividida em partes de 1/4, onde fica o número 1 inteiro em termos de quartos?
Tente contar os intervalos de 1/4 começando do zero. Onde você pararia ao contar seis desses intervalos?
O número 1 na reta equivale a 4/4. Se você precisa de 6/4, conte dois intervalos além do número 1.
Você está quase lá! O ponto deve ficar exatamente na metade do caminho entre o 1 e o 2. Tente marcar o ponto ali.

interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem?" com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); reta numérica de 0 a 2 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 4 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas); texto de apoio na reta: "The number hint is off in this problem!"; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

reta numérica; o aluno adiciona um ponto (marca a posição da fração)
grupo com m1/m2/m3, exibido depois de Convert
botão "Convert": abre as caixas do número misto (m1, m2, m3) para reescrever a fração
campo numérico da caixa de cima da fração (numerador)

erros.devolutiva: A fraction is a relationship between parts and the whole, not the sum of its two numbers. Do not add 6 and 4.
erros.buggyRule: Somar numerador e denominador para obter um valor único: {A_num} + {A_den}

erros.devolutiva: The numerator is above the fraction bar. The number 4 is below the bar, so it is the denominator.

erros.devolutiva: The denominator divides the numerator. For 6/4, the quotient is one and the remainder is two; do not reverse the fraction parts.
The numerator counts fourths, not whole-number units. Since the line goes from 0 to 2, six fourths must be between 1 and 2.
Count the intervals between marks, not the marks themselves. Six fourths lands at the second quarter mark after 1.
erros.buggyRule: Contar as marcas incluindo o ponto zero, resultando em uma posição deslocada em uma unidade

erros.devolutiva: Six fourths is greater than one, so the point must be to the right of 1, not at the halfway point between 0 and 1.

dicas.texto: Look at the top number in the fraction. It tells how many parts are being considered.
Read the fraction from top to bottom and identify the number above the fraction bar.
The fraction shown is 6/4, so focus on the first number before the slash.
Type the number of parts shown above the fraction bar into the top box.
Look at the bottom number in the fraction. It tells how many equal parts make one whole.
Read the number below the fraction bar and enter it in the bottom box.
In 6/4, the number after the slash is the denominator.
Type the number of equal parts in one whole into the bottom box.
Compare the numerator with the denominator to decide whether the fraction contains a whole.
Ask how many complete groups of 4 fit into 6.
One group of 4 fits into 6, with some parts left over.
Enter the number of complete wholes formed by the first group of four fourths.
An improper fraction can be rewritten using complete wholes and a remaining fraction.
Divide the numerator by the denominator; the quotient becomes the whole number and the remainder becomes the new numerator.
When 6 is divided by 4, the quotient is one and the remainder is two.
Click Convert after identifying one complete whole and two remaining parts with denominator four.
Use the denominator to determine how many equal intervals make each whole.
Divide each unit into four equal parts, then count six fourths from zero.
After reaching 1, move two of the four equal intervals toward 2.
Place the point halfway between 1 and 2, at the second quarter mark after 1.
Before finishing, check that the marked point represents more than one whole.
Verify that the point is two fourths to the right of 1.
The point should be halfway between 1 and 2 because it represents one and two fourths.
After confirming the point at 1.5, click Done to submit the completed representation.

The number hint is off in this problem!

hints.message: Use the denominator to determine how many equal intervals make each whole.
Divide each unit into four equal parts, then count six fourths from zero.
After reaching 1, move two of the four equal intervals toward 2.
Place the point halfway between 1 and 2, at the second quarter mark after 1.

misconceptions.description: O aluno ignora a escala fracionária e marca o ponto no número inteiro correspondente ao numerador
misconceptions.feedback: The numerator counts fourths, not whole-number units. Since the line goes from 0 to 2, six fourths must be between 1 and 2.

misconceptions.description: O aluno conta as marcas (ticks) em vez dos intervalos entre elas
misconceptions.feedback: Count the intervals between marks, not the marks themselves. Six fourths lands at the second quarter mark after 1.

misconceptions.description: O aluno ancora o valor na metade da reta (1/2) por ser uma referência familiar
misconceptions.feedback: Six fourths is greater than one, so the point must be to the right of 1, not at the halfway point between 0 and 1.

nodes.description: Click Done to finish showing 6/4 on the number line.
nodes.instruction: Click Done to finish showing 6/4 on the number line.

hints.message: Before finishing, check that the marked point represents more than one whole.
Verify that the point is two fourths to the right of 1.
The point should be halfway between 1 and 2 because it represents one and two fourths.
After confirming the point at 1.5, click Done to submit the completed representation.

nodes.description: O aluno soma os valores da fração e insere como um número inteiro
nodes.instruction: A fraction is a relationship between parts and the whole, not the sum of its two numbers. Do not add 6 and 4.

nodes.description: O aluno troca o numerador pelo denominador
nodes.instruction: The numerator is above the fraction bar. The number 4 is below the bar, so it is the denominator.

nodes.description: O aluno inverte a lógica da conversão de fração imprópria para número misto
nodes.instruction: The denominator divides the numerator. For 6/4, the quotient is one and the remainder is two; do not reverse the fraction parts.
